info.title: UAIX Browser p2pRuntime Seed Host Tool
info.description: Installable .NET tool and self-contained companion for user-run TinyRustLM model acquisition and MiniModel P2P seed fleets. It bundles reviewed MiniModel and TinyRustLM Rust executables, performs pinned source conversion on the user's computer, and never proxies model bytes through project infrastructure.
